title: Quick American Oyster Mushroom Quesadilla
description: A velvety, yeasty quesadilla with sautéed oyster mushrooms and melted cheddar, served with a low-glycemic guacamole.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in garlic, smoked paprika, and oyster mushrooms, cooking until mushrooms release moisture and brown, about 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to low, add butter and shredded cheddar, stirring until the cheese melts into a velvety sauce while the mixture becomes slightly yeasty.
Spread the mushroom-cheese mixture evenly onto one half of each tortilla, fold the other half over, and press together.
Transfer the folded tortillas to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the tortilla is golden and the cheese is fully melted.
Slice each quesadilla into wedges, garnish with cilantro, and serve hot.
